card.name: The word whichever in dose limits
card.fires_on: The word "whichever" after a comma, following two alternative limits (time, dose or weight) joined by "or". Occasionally the word right after it, such as "lower".

modes.label: Whichever after two alternatives
modes.description: "whichever" follows two options for a time or dose limit and precedes is shorter, is longer, is less or is greater.
modes.example: every 7 days or according to the pump user manual,<< whichever>> is shorter.

modes.label: Word after whichever
modes.description: The comparison word that completes the phrase, such as lower.
modes.example: not exceed 6 Units/kg or 200 Units, whichever is<< lower>>.

card.plain: It marks the point where a label says to use the shorter, longer, lesser or greater of two limits.
